subject.title: Message plugin: support Telegram forum topic management (create/edit/close/reopen)

question: Should permanent Telegram forum topic deletion be separately opt-in, default-enabled with create/edit, or excluded while close/reopen ship?
rationale: Telegram gives deletion a distinct permission and destructive effect, while OpenClaw currently defaults topic create/edit actions on; repository history cannot determine the intended public authorization and upgrade contract.

options.title: Separate deletion opt-in
options.body: Add close/reopen and introduce a dedicated disabled-by-default `deleteForumTopic` permission with explicit destructive wording.

options.title: Default-enabled full lifecycle
options.body: Add close/reopen/delete under the same default-enabled model as create/edit despite Telegram’s distinct deletion permission.

options.title: Reversible lifecycle only
options.body: Add close/reopen and leave permanent topic deletion unsupported until a broader destructive-action policy exists.

recommendation.title: Separate deletion opt-in
recommendation.body: Add close/reopen and introduce a dedicated disabled-by-default `deleteForumTopic` permission with explicit destructive wording.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the strongest current-history and canonical-discussion owner for the Telegram action/config product decision.
